title: Town library self-checkout rollout
summary: A town library network wants shorter checkout lines and less repetitive desk work.

sections.title: Situation
sections.narrative:
A town library network wants shorter checkout lines and less repetitive desk work.

Today branch staff check out every book and media item by hand. The library is considering self-checkout kiosks, but it cannot leave patrons without help and it cannot shut branches during installation.

candidate_paths.title: Path A: branch pilot with staffed support
candidate_paths.narrative: This path keeps the service legible to patrons and gives staff time to learn the new workflow before the library expands kiosks across branches.

candidate_paths.title: Path B: kiosk-first cutover
candidate_paths.narrative: This path reduces desk traffic faster, but it is brittle because it depends on full readiness and weakens the staffed fallback too early.
